text.en:
Magazine is <title refilled [G_refill] /> every 0.2 seconds based on currently remaining ammo while not firing the weapon.

Refill amount by currently remaining ammo:
• 1-2 Ammo: 4 shots
• 3-8 Ammo: 3 shots
• 9-16 Ammo: 2 shots
• 17 Ammo: 1 shot

Generates 2% Blight per hit. Not firing for 1.3 seconds drains 3.33% Blight every 1.2 seconds.

Performing a manual reload creates Blighted Seekers for 7 seconds, granting 1 Seeker for every 16.7% Blight converted. Maximum of 6 Seekers. Blight always rounds up to the next full Seeker.

Grants ? Reload Speed based on the amount of Blighted Seekers prepared.

Blighted Seekers are fired at 720 RPM while aiming down sights or 450 RPM if fired from the hip.
